messages:
mira: :rotating_light: Trivy pipeline started spitting KMS decrypt errors ~10m ago, a few GHAS findings are marked suppressed but I can't find matching suppression rule. @oliver @ramon any idea?
oliver: looking. can you paste the pod logs?
mira: kubectl logs -n scanners trivy-collector-0 --since=30m
mira: ```
2026-03-20T14:08:12Z ERROR kms decrypt failed: access denied
2026-03-20T14:08:12Z WARN fallback: marking scan as ignored due to decrypt error
2026-03-20T14:09:01Z INFO report: GHAS-suppression applied: rule-id=svc-deps-exceptions
```
ramon: that decrypt error looks like the key alias changed during last rotation. we applied a staged rotation yesterday night. Did the rotation finish for the scanner role?
priya: FYI the suppression-sync job with Snyk failed around the same time with 502 from suppression-service. logs: `POST /sync/suppressions -> 502` repeatedly.
snyk-bot: alert: suppression-sync failed 3 attempts for org/redwood-inference at 2026-03-20T14:05:43Z
jess: GHAS webhooks were also re-delivering events after we toggled the dedupe flag in the queue. duplicate events could have caused the suppression mapping to apply to the wrong scan id.
oliver: ok so 3 moving pieces: KMS rotation left scanner with stale key -> decrypt fails -> scanner bails and marks as ignored; suppression-sync failing -> local suppression state inconsistent; GHAS webhook dedupe -> wrong mapping. ugly.
mira: initial ask: are any critical CVEs being dropped because of this? ran a quick grep in the daily export and saw `CVE-2026-0421` (high, semver patch available) listed as suppressed on 6 containers that shouldn't be suppressed.
security-bot: ticket created: INC-2345 - scanner KMS decrypt + suppression mismatch (priority: P1)
ramon: mitigation plan: 1) restore previous KMS alias for scanner role (hotfix) 2) restart trivy workers to force re-decrypt 3) re-run suppression-sync after fix 4) reconcile GHAS webhook dedupe setting.
priya: I'll replay suppression-sync after KMS fix. I have a safe replay command: `curl -X POST https://suppression-service/internal/replay?since=2026-03-20T13:00Z --header 'X-Run-As: infra'`. use in maintenance window.
jess: For GHAS, toggle dedupe back to `true` in queue config, wait 2 minutes, then toggle to `false` to flush any duplicates. will coordinate with infra.
oliver: also recommend we add an audit log for suppression application: include `suppressor_id`, `source_event_id`, and `scanner_job_id` so we can trace misapplied rules. low-effort changelog: add fields to suppression-applier event payload.
mira: agree. add to postmortem. can we also add a CI gating rule: suppression-sync must succeed before daily export mark complete?
ramon: yes, we'll add a blocking check. also adding a liveness check for KMS decrypt latency > 2s to alert earlier.
priya: quick rollback plan: revert last KMS alias update in IAM console (ramon do you have perms?), then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/trivy-collector -n scanners` once alias points to old key.
ramon: I have perms, doing alias swap now. will post when done.
deploy-bot: deploy started: iam/alias-rollback by ramon @ 2026-03-20T14:19:02Z
ramon: alias swapped back. waiting for propagation (estimated 30s).
oliver: once trivy workers restart, run `snyk suppress --list --org redwood-inference | jq . | grep -i CVE-2026-0421` and confirm no unintended suppressions.
mira: restarted trivy collectors. logs: `decrypt successful` and scanners moving through backlog.
priya: suppression-sync replay completed with 0 errors. CI gating will be added as follow-up.
jess: dedupe toggle done, GHAS webhook queue no longer showing duplicate event IDs.
mira: verified CVE-2026-0421 now shows as open on 6 containers, patch available -> prioritizing patch rollout: 1) canary image update on staging, 2) schedule patch PRs for affected services, 3) notify product owners.
oliver: add opt-in auto-backport for libraries with patch-only updates. low friction and reduces churn.
ramon: postmortem action items: - add suppression-audit fields - make suppression-sync non-skippable in export pipeline - add KMS decrypt liveness alert - add runbook to revert alias safely - add CI gate for suppression-sync status.
mira: thanks everyone. I'll open the postmortem and assign INC-2345 follow-ups. anyone want to own the suppression-audit change? @oliver?
oliver: I'll take it. PR by EOD tomorrow.
mira: closing thread for now. please update INC-2345 with any follow-ups. :thumbsup:
